title: The garment becomes an address
governingQuestion: Which facts may have to travel with a product—and which rules do not yet exist?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The garment becomes an address
longform.opening: The garment is becoming an address for regulated product information.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishes an ecodesign framework that includes digital product passports and applies through later product-specific requirements.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: The EU textile strategy anticipates product-passport information for textiles; neither record proves every Paris runway look currently carries a passport.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: Textile-specific delegated rules, data fields and dates must be tracked through official EU records; no FHCM implementation is asserted.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.

spokenScript: The garment is becoming an address for regulated product information.
Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishes an ecodesign framework that includes digital product passports and applies through later product-specific requirements.
The EU textile strategy anticipates product-passport information for textiles; neither record proves every Paris runway look currently carries a passport.
The system: ESPR, product passport, textile data.
The honest limit: Textile-specific delegated rules, data fields and dates must be tracked through official EU records; no FHCM implementation is asserted.
Enter the Paris evidence edition; the receipts and permissions are attached.
